check_constraints.name: ck_alert_certainty
check_constraints.sql: certainty IS NULL OR (certainty >= 0 AND certainty <= 1)

check_constraints.name: ck_alert_chronology_confidence
check_constraints.sql: chronology_confidence IS NULL OR (chronology_confidence >= 0 AND chronology_confidence <= 1)

check_constraints.name: ck_analytics_assignment_state_consistency
check_constraints.sql: (desired_state = 'paused' AND lifecycle_state = 'blocked' AND reason_code = 'owner_gates_pending') OR (desired_state = 'paused' AND lifecycle_state = 'paused' AND reason_code = 'manual_pause') OR (desired_state = 'enabled' AND lifecycle_state = 'running' AND reason_code = 'generated_runtime_active') OR (desired_state = 'enabled' AND lifecycle_state = 'degraded' AND reason_code = 'runtime_degraded') OR (desired_state = 'enabled' AND lifecycle_state = 'failed' AND reason_code = 'runtime_failed')

check_constraints.name: ck_analytics_generated_run_failure_consistency
check_constraints.sql: (status = 'succeeded' AND failure_code IS NULL) OR (status IN ('degraded', 'failed') AND failure_code IS NOT NULL)

check_constraints.name: ck_analytics_geometry_run_close_reason
check_constraints.sql: close_reason IS NULL OR close_reason IN ('completed', 'sequence_conflict', 'reorder_buffer_overflow', 'candidate_limit', 'state_limit', 'scope_mismatch', 'timezone_unavailable', 'persistence_conflict')

check_constraints.name: ck_analytics_observation_bbox
check_constraints.sql: bbox_x >= 0 AND bbox_x <= 1 AND bbox_y >= 0 AND bbox_y <= 1 AND bbox_width > 0 AND bbox_width <= 1 AND bbox_height > 0 AND bbox_height <= 1 AND bbox_x + bbox_width <= 1 AND bbox_y + bbox_height <= 1

check_constraints.name: ck_analytics_tracker_epoch_end_consistency
check_constraints.sql: (ended_at IS NULL AND end_sequence IS NULL AND end_reason IS NULL) OR (ended_at IS NOT NULL AND end_sequence IS NOT NULL AND end_reason IS NOT NULL)

check_constraints.name: ck_analytics_tracker_epoch_end_reason
check_constraints.sql: end_reason IS NULL OR end_reason IN ('explicit_reset', 'sequence_gap', 'sequence_regression', 'timestamp_regression', 'configuration_change', 'source_change', 'worker_restart', 'resource_exhausted')

check_constraints.name: ck_analytics_tracker_epoch_sequence
check_constraints.sql: start_sequence >= 0 AND (end_sequence IS NULL OR end_sequence >= 0)

check_constraints.name: ck_analytics_tracking_run_failure_consistency
check_constraints.sql: (status = 'succeeded' AND failure_code IS NULL) OR (status = 'failed' AND failure_code = 'resource_exhausted')

check_constraints.name: ck_analytics_track_bbox
check_constraints.sql: bbox_x >= 0 AND bbox_x <= 1 AND bbox_y >= 0 AND bbox_y <= 1 AND bbox_width > 0 AND bbox_width <= 1 AND bbox_height > 0 AND bbox_height <= 1 AND bbox_x + bbox_width <= 1 AND bbox_y + bbox_height <= 1

check_constraints.name: ck_analytics_track_counters
check_constraints.sql: local_track_number >= 1 AND age_frames >= 1 AND visible_frames >= 1 AND visible_frames <= age_frames AND missed_frames >= 0

check_constraints.name: ck_cameras_coordinate_pair
check_constraints.sql: (latitude IS NULL AND longitude IS NULL) OR (latitude IS NOT NULL AND longitude IS NOT NULL)

check_constraints.name: ck_cameras_latitude_range
check_constraints.sql: latitude IS NULL OR (latitude >= -90 AND latitude <= 90)

check_constraints.name: ck_cameras_longitude_range
check_constraints.sql: longitude IS NULL OR (longitude >= -180 AND longitude <= 180)

check_constraints.name: ck_correlation_hypothesis_scores
check_constraints.sql: confidence >= 0 AND confidence <= 1 AND uncertainty >= 0 AND uncertainty <= 1

check_constraints.name: ck_onvif_operation_lifecycle
check_constraints.sql: (outcome = 'pending' AND finished_at IS NULL AND duration_ms IS NULL) OR (outcome IN ('success', 'failure') AND finished_at IS NOT NULL AND duration_ms >= 0)

check_constraints.name: ck_stream_capability_refresh_completeness
check_constraints.sql: result_completeness IS NULL OR result_completeness IN ('complete', 'partial')
